---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability or improvement
title: '[Feature] '
---

## Objective
What problem should this solve, and for whom?

## Proposed behavior
Describe the desired outcome and user experience.

## Scope and dependencies
Identify affected components, dependencies and exclusions.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Observable behavior defined.
- [ ] Relevant validation defined.

## Risks and alternatives
Consider compatibility, privacy, accessibility, cost and deployment where applicable.
